title: Video transcode worker with visibility-timeout heartbeats
name: Transcode queue worker

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this worker leases, extends, deletes, or retries queue messages? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A 1080p transcode takes 9 minutes. What keeps another worker from picking up the same message during that time?
choices: Nothing; the message becomes visible again after 120 seconds
The inFlight counter, which is shared across all worker processes
The setInterval heartbeat that resets the visibility timeout to 120 seconds every 45 seconds

questions.prompt: A message arrives whose body is not valid JSON. What happens to it?
choices: It is moved to the dead-letter queue right away, without retries
It is retried up to MAX_RECEIVES times and then dead-lettered
The exception escapes process() and stops runForever

questions.prompt: concurrency is 4, and 4 transcodes are running. What does runForever do?
choices: Calls receive with maxMessages = 0 in a tight loop
Sleeps 250 ms and checks again, without receiving, until a job finishes
Receives up to 10 more messages and queues them in memory
Waits for all four jobs to finish before receiving again
